content.title: Phillies vs Rangers highlights. Cristopher Sanchez, big HRs power Philly
content.text: March 26, 2026Updated March 27, 2026, 4:10 a.m. ETIncredibly, Phillies manager Rob Thomson said Cristopher Sanchez is just scratching the surface of how good he can be.Sanchez dominated the Texas Rangers through six shutout innings, giving up just three hits, no walks while striking out 10 in the Phillies' 5-3 win on Opening Day at Citizens Bank Park on March 26. Sanchez became the first Phillies pitcher to strike out 10 or more on Opening Day since Curt Schilling struck out 11 to start the 1997 season."Everything," Thomson said when asked what he liked about Sanchez's start. "Efficient, getting ahead in the count. The changeup was falling off the table. Pounding the zone. A lot of soft contact. Ten strikeouts, no walks."Buy Philadelphia Phillies ticketsThomson added Sanchez's changeup gets better as the game goes on.That was evident as Sanchez ended his outing by striking out the side in the sixth inning. He then walked off the mound and pumped his fist, knowing his day was over after throwing 87 pitches."Those are emotions that come out during the game," Sanchez said through a team interpreter. "Things happen when you're having a performance like this. You just gotta let it out sometimes. That's what happened there."But the Phillies had to sweat out the ninth inning after taking a 5-0 lead into the inning. That's because the Rangers scored two quick runs on Jake Burger's homer with no one out. Eventually, closer Jhoan Duran came in to get the final two outs to preserve the victory.Sanchez had plenty of help offensively. Kyle Schwarber, who hit 56 homers last season, hit a two-run shot in the first inning for an early lead. Then Alec Bohm hit a three-run shot in the fifth.Rookie Justin Crawford, making his major-league debut, singled on the first pitch that he saw and went 2-for-4. Trea Turner, batting leadoff, had two hits and two runs scored.It was about as well as an Opening Day could go for the Phillies. That is, until the ninth. Still, the Phillies have high expectations as the 162-game season begins. They're hoping to reach the MLB postseason for a fifth straight season, which would match the playoff run of the 2007-11 teams as the most in team history.This Phillies' run, however, has so far come without a World Series championship. The Phillies, in fact, have lost in the NLDS in each of the last two seasons.Sanchez will be a big part of that. He went 13-5 with a 2.50 ERA last season. He's been the team's ace ever since Zack Wheeler underwent shoulder surgery last fall, costing him the final month of last season and the postseason.So Thomson was asked if Sanchez can be even better than he was last season."So far, he's been really good," Thomson said with a laugh. "His confidence just gets better and better, higher and higher. Who knows where it goes?"The Delaware News Journal provided live coverage of the 2026 season opener. Here are the highlights: Alec Bohm hits 3-run homer, Phillies lead 5-0Just when it seemed like Rangers starter Nathan Eovaldi would escape after giving up back-to-back singles to start the fifth, Alec Bohm hit a 3-run homer two outs later to give the Phillies a 5-0 lead.Justin Crawford and Trea Turner each got their second hits of the game. But Kyle Schwarber, who homered earlier, struck out, as did Bryce Harper. Bohm then hit a 1-and-0 pitch over the right-field fence to chase Eovaldi.Bohm is not considered a prototypical No. 4 hitter. He has never hit more than 20 home runs in any of his previous five full seasons, nor has he driven in 100 runs or more."For me, it kind of reaffirms that I'm not up there trying too hard," Bohm said. "If I'm up there trying too hard, then I'm not giving myself a chance ... and I end up chasing." Cristopher Sanchez is dealing, Phillies lead 5-0 through 6 inningsPhillies starter Cristopher Sanchez is picking up where he left off last season. Sanchez gave up two singles in the first inning, and very little since. Sanchez struck out 10 through 6 innings, giving up just three singles total. Sanchez got a standing ovation as he walked off the mound as that was probably his last inning. Sanchez threw 87 pitches through the six innings.Sanchez became the first Phillies pitcher with double-digit strikeouts on Opening Day since Curt Schilling did it in 1997. Justin Crawford singles in first major-league at-batJustin Crawford, the Phillies' rookie, wasn't waiting around. In his first major-league at-bat, he singled to center field on the first pitch he saw from Rangers starter Nathan Eovaldi. The hit came with two outs and no one on.He got a standing ovation from the fans at Citizens Bank Park.Crawford was stranded as Trea Turner flew out to left field on a diving catch by Sam Haggerty. Otherwise, Crawford would have scored. The Phillies lead 2-0 after 2 innings. Kyle Schwarber HR in 1st inning, Phillies lead 2-0That didn't take long. In his first at-bat of 2026, Kyle Schwarber hit a two-run homer, giving the Phillies a 2-0 lead. Trea Turner led off with a single and Schwarber followed with a homer to left-center on a 1-2 pitch. It wasn't a true Schwar-bomb, however, as it went only 383 feet and the exit velocity was 99.6 mph. But it was far enough. And for Schwarber, who hit 56 homers last season, it was a good start.Schwarber also homered on Opening Day last season, and again in 2022, his first with the Phillies. Cristopher Sanchez gets out of 1st-inning mini jamThe Rangers didn't hit a ball in the air in the first inning as the first two batters grounded out and the next two singled up the middle out of the reach of shortstop Trea Turner, putting runners on first and second with two outs.Sanchez then struck out Andrew McCutchen to end the inning. Sanchez ended up throwing 19 pitches in the first inning. Zack Wheeler update on Phillies ace bullpen sessionPhillies ace Zack Wheeler threw a bullpen session before the opener on March 26, and he was on hand as the team was introduced before the game. Phillies manager Rob Thomson said it was too soon to say how the bullpen session went. But the plan is for Wheeler to begin a rehab assignment on March 28 at Triple-A Lehigh Valley.Wheeler was shut down last August for thoracic outlet syndrome. He had surgery last fall and could make his 2026 debut before the end of April.Thomson said Wheeler is slated to throw three innings on March 28, or 50 pitches, whichever comes first. Where is Justin Crawford hitting in Phillies Opening Day lineup?As expected, rookie Justin Crawford is making his MLB debut. Crawford is batting ninth and playing center field. And he's excited about it, as he said before the game:"I got a lot of confidence," he said. "I'm excited to finally be here. I'm excited to get out there and go play."The rest of the Phillies lineup goes like this: 1. Trea Turner, SS; 2. Kyle Schwarber, DH; 3. Bryce Harper, 1B; 4. Alec Bohm, 3B; 5. Bryson Stott, 2B; 6. Adolis Garcia, RF; 7. Brandon Marsh, LF; 8. J.T. Realmuto, C; 9, Crawford, CF. Who's pitching for Phillies vs Rangers?Cristopher Sanchez is starting for the Phillies. The lefty went 13-5 with a 2.50 ERA in 2025. He struck out 212 in 202 innings. Sanchez is making his first Opening Day start.Nathan Eovaldi is pitching for the Rangers. The righty went 11-3 with a 1.73 ERA in 2025. He struck out 129 in 130 innings.What's the weather forecast for Phillies Opening Day 2026?It's going to be a perfect day for baseball. The forecast is calling for a partly sunny day with highs in the 70s. As the game goes on, the temperatures will drop into the mid- to upper 60s.There will be rain in the evening, but according to the National Weather Service, it should hold off until the late evening or overnight hours.Contact Martin Frank at mfrank@delawareonline.com.
